text:
Maya Alvarez: Quick ask - hiring team wants to offer Elena (Data Infra Engineer) a band exception. Current comp plan would be M4 but they want M5 provisional + $8k sign-on. Candidate can start earlier if we expedite. Thoughts?
Jacob Stern: Why uplift? counteroffer? retention?
Maya Alvarez: Competing offer + relocation package theyd prefer. Manager says candidates market rate aligns with M5. Also wants start date moved up by 10 days.
Priya Kapoor: Okay routing checklist: band-exception form, sign-on approval, start-date exception, payroll impact.
hr-ops-bot: Request 3501234567 logged. Approvers: Comp Committee, Payroll Ops, Legal (if sign-on > $5k). Deadline 72h.
Jacob Stern: Legal trigger noted (sign-on > 5k). If legal signs off on clawback language we should be fine.
Payroll Ops: Manual payroll possible but needs submission before payroll lock. Provide exact start date and cost center.
Maya Alvarez: Proposed start 2026-06-01 (current default 2026-06-11). Cost center ENG-DATA; manager to confirm invoice code.
Priya Kapoor: I'll route to comp committee now.
Comp Committee: Quick review - can we do provisional M5? Provide justification doc and manager sign-off.
Maya Alvarez: Uploaded manager justification: candidate seniority, competing offer comp, relocation urgency.
Comp Committee: Approved provisional M5 for 72-day review period. Sign-on $8k approved pending Legal clawback language.
hr-ops-bot: Update - Comp Committee=approved; Legal=pending; Payroll Ops=pending.
Priya Kapoor: Legal please review clutch clause. Also confirm whether sign-on > $5k needs additional tax guidance.
Payroll Ops: If Legal approves and we get invoice code by EOD we can still hit manual payroll for 2026-06-01. Otherwise earliest start 2026-06-15.
Maya Alvarez: Manager DMd invoice code XYZ-889 by 2pm.
Legal Team: Drafted clawback clause and approved sign-on payment terms. No further issues.
hr-ops-bot: Final approvals: Comp Committee=approved, Legal=approved, Payroll Ops=approved.
Priya Kapoor: Excellent. Maya, proceed to send updated offer letter with provisional band M5, $8k sign-on, clawback clause, start date 2026-06-01. cc payroll ops.
Maya Alvarez: Sending now. Candidate notified to accept within 48h. Will update when signed.
Jacob Stern: Flag to onboarding to prep relocation packet earlier if candidate accepts.
Maya Alvarez: Thanks everyone. Closing thread when candidate accepts.
